paths.scope: Exact QML-button service upgrade, denial/retry, runtime/access/history continuity, manager restart, native desktop activation/recovery and metadata import regression

validation.source_regressions: Full Go suite on final performance product code; focused race/vet and real isolated OpenSSH authorization/revocation/non-replay. Stable version strings differ from RC; backend source digest is identical. Protected full source/race/QML CI must pass on the distribution head before publication.

scope_limits: The service rehearsal covers 0.3.4 to 0.3.5 on an offline pristine Arch/Omarchy Linux/AMD64 owner-user stack. Earlier releases require documented intermediate upgrades to 0.3.4. Remote upgrades, other distro runtime installations and power cuts were not qualified in this pass.
Real QML buttons use an exact-program guest-only polkit rule, not human password entry. The initial setup receipt is reconstructed from genuine previous-version installer and SSH enrollment evidence.

The guest uses real sealed desktop archives with harness activation acknowledgements. A separate private native QML test covers actual hot/cold activation, failed-candidate recovery, preferences and restart. Stock updater interaction remains a manual review step.

Performance measurements are controlled component fixtures, not total compositor CPU, GPU load or laptop battery/watt-hours. Fifty view cycles are not long-duration leak qualification; visible CPU gains are not claimed.

Owner storage accounting cannot read 18 DEV overlay work directories. An additional 4 GiB reserve is charged separately from the 4 GiB guest scratch cap under the combined 40 GiB budget. Prior temporary performance scratch was removed by the workstation reboot; durable compact evidence remains.

Only newly created disposable fake ships and synthetic metadata were tested. No protected production pier, ~/temp-ur, installed production plugin/service or human DEV review state was used or changed.

Schema 47, desktop format 1 and bootstrap API 1 are unchanged. Identity, authorization, revocation and mutation non-replay safeguards remain. Cross-host handoff and existing experimental-feature/security-review limits remain.

The first stable rehearsal was interrupted by a workstation reboot before its upgrade step. Its incomplete result is not qualification or a successful power-cut test. A new offline guest repeated the complete scenario using the same immutable artifacts.
policy: Immutable frozen stable artifacts. Protected source/race/QML/release-policy checks and reviewed merge commit required before publication; no bypass. Publication does not upgrade installed services or plugins.
